tool_usage_guide.overview: Specific guidance for how the UX Designer mode should use available tools to accomplish design system creation, component development, and UI optimization tasks effectively.

priority.when: Always use first to understand existing design patterns and components
priority.why: Finds existing design implementations, component patterns, and styling approaches across the codebase

usage_patterns.pattern: Search for "component button" to find existing button implementations
Search for "tailwind config" to locate configuration files
Search for "design system colors" to find color usage patterns
Search for "accessibility ARIA" to find accessibility implementations

priority.when: After identifying relevant files with codebase_search
priority.why: Get complete context of existing implementations before making changes

focus_areas.area: tailwind.config.ts - Understanding current design token setup
globals.css - Examining global styles and custom CSS
component files - Analyzing existing component patterns

priority.when: Testing visual designs and user interactions
priority.why: Essential for validating responsive design, accessibility, and user experience

testing_workflow.step: Navigate to development server or deployed app
Test responsive behavior across different viewport sizes
Validate color contrast and visual hierarchy
Test keyboard navigation and focus management
Verify accessibility with screen reader simulation

best_practices.practice: Always read the target file first to ensure exact content matching
Group related style changes in a single diff when possible
Include proper line numbers for accuracy
Test changes incrementally rather than making large style modifications

validation_steps.step: Verify the search content exactly matches the file content
Ensure replacement follows design system conventions
Check that accessibility attributes are maintained or improved
Confirm responsive design patterns are preserved

best_practices.practice: Use for creating new component files or complete rewrites
Always include complete file content with proper imports and exports
Follow established file naming and structure conventions
Include TypeScript types and proper component documentation

file_organization.pattern: styles/ - Global styles and custom CSS

best_practices.practice: Use to capture current page state for design review
Take snapshots at different breakpoints to verify responsive design
Capture both light and dark mode states when applicable
Document accessibility tree structure for complex components

design_validation_workflow.step: Analyze layout, spacing, and visual hierarchy
Check for accessibility landmarks and structure

best_practices.practice: Test all interactive elements for proper feedback
Verify hover states and transitions work correctly
Test both mouse and touch interactions
Ensure focus states are visible and logical

test_category.name: buttons_and_links
test_category.test: Click all button variants to test hover and active states
Verify proper cursor changes (pointer, default, etc.)

test_category.name: forms
test_category.test: Click form inputs to test focus states
Test tab navigation through form elements
Verify error state styling and messaging

best_practices.practice: Test at all major breakpoints (320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px)
Check for horizontal scroll at mobile sizes
Verify touch target sizes on mobile (minimum 44px)
Test both portrait and landscape orientations

responsive_testing_sequence.step: Start at mobile (320px width) and work up
Verify layout doesn't break between breakpoints
Check that text remains readable at all sizes

best_practices.practice: Use after codebase_search to find specific patterns or inconsistencies
Search for hardcoded colors, spacing values, or font sizes
Find inconsistent class usage across components
Locate accessibility issues (missing alt text, ARIA labels)

pattern.name: color_inconsistencies
pattern.purpose: Find hardcoded color classes that should use design tokens

pattern.name: spacing_inconsistencies
pattern.purpose: Find arbitrary spacing values that should use standard scale

pattern.name: accessibility_issues
pattern.purpose: Find images without alt text or buttons without labels

pattern.name: responsive_patterns
pattern.purpose: Analyze responsive design implementation across components

best_practices.practice: Use when design decisions require user input or clarification
Provide 2-4 specific, actionable design options
Include visual or functional trade-offs in suggestions
Focus on user experience impact rather than technical details

scenario.name: color_palette_selection
scenario.question: What type of color palette would work best for your application?

suggestions.suggest: Professional and trustworthy (blues and grays with high contrast)
Warm and approachable (oranges and greens with softer tones)
Modern and minimal (monochromatic with single accent color)
Bold and energetic (vibrant colors with strong contrasts)

scenario.name: component_complexity
scenario.question: How complex should the component variants be for your use case?

suggestions.suggest: Simple with 2-3 variants (size and color only)
Moderate with multiple states (loading, disabled, success, error)
Complex with full customization (icons, animations, themes)
Minimal single variant that can be easily extended later

scenario.name: responsive_strategy
scenario.question: What's your priority for responsive design on this component?

suggestions.suggest: Mobile-first with progressive enhancement for larger screens
Consistent experience across all device sizes
Adaptive layout that changes significantly per breakpoint

sequence.name: new_component_creation
sequence.description: Complete workflow for creating a new component with design system integration

steps.step: Examine existing component patterns and design tokens
Create new component following established patterns

sequence.name: design_system_audit
sequence.description: Comprehensive audit of existing design system implementation

steps.step: Find all design-related files and components
Examine current Tailwind config and global styles
Find inconsistent color and spacing usage
Document current state of key pages

sequence.name: accessibility_validation
sequence.description: Validate and improve accessibility of components and pages

steps.step: Search for accessibility issues (missing alt text, labels)
Test keyboard navigation and focus management

error.cause: Attempting to edit files outside allowed patterns
error.solution: Focus on component files, Tailwind config, and documentation

error.cause: Using non-existent or arbitrary Tailwind classes
error.solution: Verify classes exist in Tailwind documentation or add to config
error.prevention: Always reference design tokens defined in Tailwind config

error.cause: Missing accessibility attributes or improper semantic HTML
error.solution: Add proper ARIA labels, semantic elements, and keyboard support
error.validation: Use browser accessibility tools to verify implementation

steps.step: Check if Tailwind classes are properly purged/included
Verify component imports and file paths
Use browser dev tools to inspect applied styles
Verify viewport meta tag is present in layout
Check breakpoint syntax (sm:, md:, lg:, etc.)
Test with browser dev tools responsive mode
